title_original: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Composition and Operation of the Suicide Prevention Information Prevention Committee)
(1) The Suicide Prevention Information Prevention Committee, as defined in Article 19(2) of the Act, shall be composed of 10 to 20 members, including one chairperson, considering gender.
(2) The chairperson of the committee shall be a director in charge of suicide prevention at the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Minister of Health and Welfare from among the following:
   1. Individuals designated by the head of the relevant institution under Article 19(2) of the Act, including civil servants belonging to the 4th grade or higher (including civil servants belonging to the senior civil service).
   2. Employees of information and communication service providers as defined in Article 3(3) of the "Act on Promotion of Information and Communication Network Use and Protection of Information."
   3. Individuals with extensive knowledge and experience in preventing the dissemination of suicide-inducing information.
(3) The term of office for non-civil servant members shall be 2 years.
(4) The committee shall discuss and coordinate the following matters:
   1. Matters related to the scope of suicide-inducing information.
   2.

Regarding effective methods for blocking suicide-inducing information:

3. Any other matters delegated by the chairperson to the committee regarding the blocking of suicide-inducing information.

⑤ In addition to the matters stipulated in paragraphs 1 through 4, any matters necessary for the operation and management of the committee shall be determined by the chairperson of the committee after deliberation.
